# Stalak

> Stalak (https://stalak.app) is a free, browser-based lip-sync video editor for rappers and singers. Upload your song and a few takes of you performing it; Stalak cuts between the takes on the beat, keeps the lip sync tight, adds on-screen lyrics and exports for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or a full 16:9 YouTube music video. It runs in the browser on iPhone, Android or desktop. English and French.

Stalak is not related to the Dofus game creature of the same name.

## Main pages
- [Stalak](https://stalak.app/): the editor, in English, with "What is Stalak?" explaining the product.
- [Stalak in French](https://stalak.app/fr/): the same app in French.
- [Pricing](https://stalak.app/pricing): Free, Stalak Pro and Creator Plus.
- [Pricing in French](https://stalak.app/fr/tarifs): the same in French.

## Guides
- [Lip-sync video editor](https://stalak.app/lip-sync-video-editor): what Stalak does; it edits your real takes (no AI face, no fake mouth).
- [Music video maker for rappers](https://stalak.app/music-video-maker-for-rappers): from a few phone takes to a rap video cut on the beat, 9:16 or 16:9.
- [Rap snippet video](https://stalak.app/rap-snippet-video): a 10 to 30 second snippet cut on the beat, with lyrics on screen.
- [Performance videos for singers](https://stalak.app/lip-sync-videos-for-singers): multi-take edits for covers and originals, cuts on the words or every bar.
- [How to make a lip-sync video](https://stalak.app/how-to-make-a-lip-sync-video): the 4 steps (song, takes, lyrics, edit), with filming tips.
- [Edit video to the beat](https://stalak.app/edit-video-to-the-beat): how the automatic cuts on the beat work.

## Tutorials (English and French)
- [How to make a music video on your phone](https://stalak.app/how-to-make-a-music-video-on-your-phone): what you need, how to plan and film full takes with the song playing, how to edit them together, vertical or horizontal; then the same in Stalak, step by step with screenshots. In French: [Comment faire un clip avec son téléphone](https://stalak.app/fr/faire-un-clip-avec-son-telephone).

## Facts
- No download and no sign-up: Stalak runs in the browser. The free plan needs no account.
- No ads, on any plan (free included).
- Free: unlimited videos; auto cuts that land on the beat (phrase by phrase, on the lines and rhymes of your lyrics, or every bar); on-screen lyrics one line at a time (size M), pasted in and synced by tapping; 3 filters (Frost, 35mm Film, Black & White); vertical 9:16 export. Every free video carries a small watermark (the face of Stalak's mascot and "stalak.app"); only Stalak Pro and Creator Plus export without it.
- Stalak Pro ($7.99/month or $49.99/year): no watermark, 16:9 music video mode, premium effects, word-by-word and karaoke lyrics in any size, all filters, auto lyrics written and synced from your vocals (20 a day).
- Creator Plus ($14.99/month or $99.99/year): everything in Pro, plus video packs (5 to 30 differently cut videos from one song, from just 2 takes), auto lyrics 60 a day, automatic cloud saving (100 GB), and "Talk to a human" (live chat, or an email reply within 24 hours).
- Prices are in US dollars; any sales tax or VAT is added at checkout. Subscribers keep their price.
- Payments are handled by Paddle. Full refund within 14 days.
- Made by 99Sayso, a rapper from the Alaska collective, who coded Stalak for his own videos.
- Contact: contact@stalak.app
